user.title: Scheduled Helpers
user.description: Choose which kind of schedule-driven helper to create.

combine.title: Combine Sensor
combine.description: Functional clone of the built-in "Combine the state of several sensors" helper, except it updates on a fixed schedule instead of reacting to every source state change.

data_description.sources: One or more entities whose numeric state will be combined. A source that's unavailable or non-numeric at update time is skipped rather than treated as an error. If both a device class and a unit are set below, a source reporting a different but convertible unit (e.g. inHg vs psi for a pressure device class) is converted before combining; a source in a completely unrelated unit is skipped like any other unusable source.
data_description.aggregation: How to combine the current source values into the sensor's state.
data_description.hour: Hour field of the update schedule: an exact hour (0-23), a step value like `/2` for every 2nd hour, or blank. Leaving this blank means "every hour" -- only set it if the schedule should be limited to specific hours.
data_description.minute: Minute field of the update schedule: an exact minute (0-59), a step value like `/5` (the suggested default), or blank. If second is set to a specific value below, a blank minute means "every minute"; otherwise a blank minute means "at minute 0".
data_description.second: Second field of the update schedule: an exact second (0-59), a step value like `/30`, or blank. A blank second means "at second 0", not "every second". At least one of hour, minute, or second must be set to a specific value or step.
data_description.entity_category: Allows marking an entity as device configuration or diagnostics. An entity with a category will be hidden by default from the dashboard, but still available in the entity list.

template.title: Template Sensor
template.description: Functional clone of the built-in Template sensor, except it updates on a fixed schedule instead of reacting to every state change referenced in the template.

data_description.state_template: Jinja2 template rendered on each scheduled tick to produce the sensor's state.
data_description.availability_template: Optional Jinja2 template rendered before the state template on each tick; if it renders falsy, the entity is marked unavailable and the state template is not rendered.
data_description.hour: Hour field of the update schedule: an exact hour (0-23), a step value like `/2` for every 2nd hour, or blank. Leaving this blank means "every hour" -- only set it if the schedule should be limited to specific hours.
data_description.minute: Minute field of the update schedule: an exact minute (0-59), a step value like `/5` (the suggested default), or blank. If second is set to a specific value below, a blank minute means "every minute"; otherwise a blank minute means "at minute 0".
data_description.second: Second field of the update schedule: an exact second (0-59), a step value like `/30`, or blank. A blank second means "at second 0", not "every second". At least one of hour, minute, or second must be set to a specific value or step.
data_description.entity_category: Allows marking an entity as device configuration or diagnostics. An entity with a category will be hidden by default from the dashboard, but still available in the entity list.
